summary: A Microsoft chatbot on Twitter that was meant to learn from the people it talked to. Within hours users had taught it to post offensive messages, and Microsoft switched it off 16 hours after launch. It became the standard warning about letting an AI learn from the public.

events.note: Microsoft takes Tay offline about 16 hours after launch.
On 30 March 2016 Microsoft put Tay back online by accident during testing, then removed it again.

cause: Switched off after users taught it to post offensive messages.
